description.zh:
是否强制删除源文件，取值：
- **false**：否，默认值。
- **true**：是。

> 当视频转码模式为不转码或异步转码时，由于源文件会作为原画用于播放，默认不可删除该视频的源文件，此时，若需要强制删除该视频的源文件，可将本参数设置为**true**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to force delete the source file. Valid values:

- **false**: No. This is the default value.

- **true**: Yes.

> If the video transcoding mode is no transcoding or asynchronous transcoding, the source file is used for playback in the original quality. By default, you cannot delete the source file of the video. To force delete the source file, set this parameter to **true**.

description.zh: 自定义 ID 列表。由一个或多个自定义 ID 组成，多个 ID 之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持 20 个。
description.en: The list of custom IDs. You can specify up to 20 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
待删除源文件的音/视频ID列表。一次最多支持20个音/视频ID，多个ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看音/视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 音/视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
description.en:
The IDs of the audio or video files whose source files are to be deleted. You can specify up to 20 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). Obtain the IDs in one of the following ways:

- For audio or video files uploaded in the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Library** > **Audio/Video** to view the IDs.

- The audio or video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response to the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation.

- After an audio or video file is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the audio or video ID. The ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.

title.zh: 批量删除音视频源文件

descriptions.zh: 点播的媒体处理操作（转码、截图、审核等）均是对源文件的操作，因此源文件一旦删除，后续的媒体处理操作将无法进行，请慎重操作。
descriptions.en: All media processing operations in ApsaraVideo VOD, such as transcoding, snapshotting, and reviewing, are performed on source files. If a source file is deleted, subsequent media processing operations cannot be performed. Therefore, delete source files with caution.
